data.description:
The security guard of the apartment complex, bribable with scrap. For a small fee he grants access to the live CCTV footage of the apartment rooms, giving you an estimate of how valuable the contents are, and which room might be undefended.
You can then purchase a master key, which gives the ability to break into an occupied room or rentable shop to steal any items inside - one time use.
